messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use video 0 as the starting point and apply the following edit to it: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands facing forward, then turns his head and body to his left, raises his right hand to his chin, and shifts his weight while looking around.","camera":"Static, low-angle full-body shot from the front.","clothing":"Light blue cable-knit sweater, dark navy trousers, white socks, and brown loafers.","hair_color":"Bright green.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-up hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young man with a slim build, light skin, and a short beard.","scene":"A stylized urban street with tall buildings, Japanese signage, a construction crane, and wet pavement reflecting the surroundings."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a sunny road under a concrete overpass to a stylized city street with tall buildings, Japanese signs, a crane, and wet pavement, closely matching the reference. The man remains in the same low-angle full-body framing and performs the same standing, turning, and hand-to-chin actions. The lighting on the person now appears warmer and more consistent with the new urban environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original road/underpass scene with the reference urban environment, changing only the environment and its lighting on the person while preserving identity, appearance, expression, action, camera framing, and movement.
uncertain: Whether the hair color change was caused by the new lighting or is an unintended identity/appearance change.
unexpected_changes: The person's hair appears bright green in the output, whereas it looked brown/blond in the source frames.
